home.hero.desc: SLN Enterprise LLC delivers professional cleaning with the attention to detail your home or business deserves. Every visit. Every time.
home.services.sub: From weekly maintenance to full move-out deep cleans, we adapt to what your property actually needs.
home.why.sub: There are a lot of cleaning companies in Seattle. Here's what makes us different — and why our clients stay.
home.why.1.title: Vetted Professionals Only
home.why.1.desc: Every team member passes a background check and completes hands-on training before entering a client's property.
home.why.2.title: Consistent Every Visit
home.why.2.desc: We follow a detailed checklist on every clean, so you always know exactly what was done and nothing is skipped.
home.why.3.title: We Respect Your Space
home.why.3.desc: Your home is personal. We treat it with discretion, care, and attention to the details that matter to you.
home.why.4.title: AI-Powered 24/7 Support
home.why.4.desc: Questions at 3am? Our AI assistant Alexis is always on — so you never have to wait for a response.
home.testimonials.1.quote: "I've tried three different cleaning services in Seattle and SLN is the only one I've kept. They actually clean the things others skip — baseboards, light switches, behind appliances. Worth every penny."
home.testimonials.2.quote: "We hired SLN for a move-out clean on a two-bedroom apartment and got our full deposit back. Thorough, professional, and done faster than expected. Couldn't recommend them more."
home.testimonials.3.quote: "Our office looks better than it did when we moved in. The team is reliable, respectful, and never misses a week. A clean workspace has genuinely changed things for our team."
home.cta.title1: Ready for a Space That Feels
home.cta.sub: Get a free, no-pressure quote. Our AI assistant is available right now — even at 3am.

services.faq.sub: Can't find what you're looking for? Our AI assistant Alexis is available 24/7 — just open the chat.
services.faq.1.q: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
services.faq.1.a: Not at all. Many clients provide a key or entry code. We treat your home with the same care whether you're there or not — and we'll send you a confirmation when we finish.
services.faq.2.q: Do you bring your own supplies and equipment?
services.faq.2.a: Yes — we bring everything. Professional-grade, eco-friendly products and all necessary equipment. If you have a preferred product you'd like us to use, just let us know.
services.faq.3.a: Yes. SLN Enterprise LLC is fully bonded and insured. Every team member is background-checked before their first day. You're protected.
services.faq.4.q: What if I'm not satisfied with the clean?
services.faq.4.a: We'll return within 24 hours and make it right at no charge. Just let us know what wasn't up to standard and we'll address it immediately.
services.faq.5.q: How quickly can I get a quote?
services.faq.5.a: Instantly — just open the chat widget and our AI assistant Alexis will walk you through it right now, even at 3am. Or fill out the contact form and a team member will follow up within 24 hours.
services.cta.sub: Tell us about your space and we'll recommend the right fit — no pressure, no commitment.
about.h1.desc: SLN Enterprise LLC isn't just another cleaning company. We're a Seattle-based team that takes the work seriously — because the spaces people live and work in actually matter.
about.pullquote: Every home we clean belongs to someone who works hard. That space deserves to be treated with real care.
about.pullattr: SLN Enterprise LLC  ·  Founded in Seattle, WA
about.story.p1: SLN Enterprise LLC was founded on a simple belief: professional cleaning shouldn't feel like a gamble. Too many people had hired services that showed up late, skipped corners, or sent different unfamiliar faces every time with no consistency or accountability.
about.story.p2: We built something different. A team that shows up on time, follows a thorough process on every visit, and actually communicates clearly with clients. Not just a cleaning crew — a reliable partner for your home or business.
about.story.p3: We've grown through word of mouth, one satisfied client at a time. And we plan to keep it that way — doing quality work, standing behind every clean, and treating every space we enter with the respect it deserves.
about.values.1.title: Trustworthiness
about.values.1.desc: You're inviting us into your home. Every team member is background-checked and trained before they ever step through a client's door.
about.values.2.title: Consistency
about.values.2.desc: We use the same detailed checklist on every visit. Whether it's your first clean or your fiftieth, the standard never changes.
about.values.3.title: Responsibility
about.values.3.desc: We use eco-friendly, non-toxic products wherever possible — because clean shouldn't come at the cost of your health or the environment.
about.values.4.title: Communication
about.values.4.desc: We respond fast, confirm appointments, and are easy to reach. Our AI assistant is available 24/7 so you're never left waiting.
about.promise.sub: We're not just trying to show up and check boxes. We're trying to be the cleaning service you actually stick with — the one you tell your friends about.
about.promise.1: If you're not satisfied, we return within 24 hours and make it right — no questions, no charge.
about.promise.2: We never send unchecked strangers to your home. Every team member is vetted and trained directly by us.
about.promise.3: Your pricing is locked in. No surprise fees, no bait-and-switch quotes after the first visit.
about.promise.4: Reschedule, adjust, or cancel with reasonable notice — no complicated hoops or penalties.
about.promise.5: We bring every supply and piece of equipment. You don't need to provide a single thing.
about.certs.1.title: Fully Insured
about.certs.1.desc: General liability coverage on every job
about.certs.2.title: Bonded
about.certs.2.desc: You're protected from the moment we arrive
about.certs.3.title: Background Checked
about.certs.3.desc: Every team member, verified before day one
about.certs.4.title: Satisfaction Guarantee
about.certs.4.desc: We return if you're not completely happy
about.area.p1: We're based in Seattle and serve residential and commercial clients across King County and surrounding areas. From Capitol Hill apartments to Bellevue office buildings — we're close by and ready.
about.area.p2: Not sure if we cover your area? Reach out and ask. We're always looking to expand where we can serve clients well.
